My boss recommended Wispr Flow to me after using it for about six months himself. He raved about it constantly and kept telling me how much it would improve my productivity. I finally gave in and downloaded it and I have to admit he was right. It's incredibly user-friendly and I've had absolutely no issues or glitches. It does exactly what it's supposed to do and it does it well.

I was already a regular user of talk-to-text so I honestly wasn't convinced Wispr Flow would be that much different. I couldn't have been more wrong. It's significantly better and I didn't realize how much I was missing until I started using it. Today I upgraded to the Pro plan for the first time and I can confidently say I don't see myself ever going back. It's become one of those tools I didn't know I needed but now can't imagine working without!
